nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Continuous improvement initiatives_qna_000
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the focus of MSIs that follow the continuous improvement model?
nodes.answer: MSIs that follow the continuous improvement model focus on jointly developing principles and indicators to capture and achieve self-imposed sustainability goals negotiated by participating actors and stakeholder groups.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Continuous improvement initiatives_qna_001
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What is the goal of the continuous improvement model in MSI practices?
nodes.answer: The goal of the continuous improvement model in MSI practices is to achieve successive improvements across a sector's entire set of relationships along the global value chain.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Continuous improvement initiatives_qna_002
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How does the analysis of MSI according to the continuous improvement model contribute to the current state of the art?
nodes.answer: Analyzing an MSI according to the continuous improvement model contributes to the current state of the art by expanding the understanding of negotiation between heterogeneous actors with divergent goals, which has been primarily studied in standard-setting certification initiatives.
